svg.title: DEV
svg.text: Risk-coverage by information set (attribution, axis M)
Risk = error + c * abstention (lower is better); coverage = share of members answered. Rows: noise stratum x abstention cost c.
Not plotted (method emits no attribution, axis M output): CCC v1.2.2.

Where curves coincide, the top-drawn marker is CCC v1.2.2 (largest dot); coincident methods emitted identical outputs. Native binary methods have one or two curve points (confidence ties kept whole). Weighted risk has no binomial CI.
Bayes-given-S uses only the design class prior given the view; it is a ceiling for methods restricted to that set, under the uniform design prior.
